Product.title: Product
Product.description: Priya Furniture ERP product document compatible with all 59 static catalogue models. Identified strictly by composite ID `${categoryId}-${normalizedCode}` because PF codes repeat across categories.

id.description: Composite unique document ID (e.g. barber-chairs-pf-001). Never relies on productCode alone.

slug.description: URL-safe unique product slug matching id.

productCode.description: Official Priya Furniture model code within its category (e.g. PF 001). Not globally unique.

features.description: Bounded list (up to 20 strings) of key product features.

specifications.description: Bounded list (up to 20 objects with label/value strings) of technical specifications.

imagePaths.description: Primary product image paths (deployment-independent relative or storage paths, up to 12).

additionalImagePaths.description: Additional supplementary image paths when available (up to 12).

indicativeBaseRateInr.description: Preliminary indicative base reference rate in INR (0 to 10000000, or null when quote-only). Not a fixed selling price.

pricingMode.description: Pricing semantics marker preventing indicative starting rates from being treated as fixed selling prices.

isCustomizable.description: Indicates whether finish, colour, upholstery, or dimensional customisation is supported.

customizationOptions.description: Optional list of supported customisation notes.

featured.description: Highlights flagship models on overview pages.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp set on creation.

updatedAt.description: Firestore server timestamp updated on modification.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Ordered Priya Furniture product category preserving the four existing collections while supporting future ERP categories.

id.description: Unique category document ID (e.g. pedicure-manicure, barber-chairs, hairwash-stations, facial-beds).

name.description: Full display name of the category.

shortName.description: Optional compact label for navigation tabs.

cataloguePdfPath.description: Optional deployment-independent printable PDF catalogue path.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp set on creation.

updatedAt.description: Firestore server timestamp updated on modification.

Address.title: Address
Address.description: Structured billing or shipping address stored on user profiles (PII).

User.title: User
User.description: Firebase Auth user profile containing PII and server-controlled role metadata. Owner-only get/create/update with strict schema validation; zero list/delete access and zero client role escalation.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the /users/{userId} document ID.

email.description: Primary account email address matching Firebase Auth email (PII).

phoneNumber.description: Optional primary contact telephone number (PII; empty string when omitted).

accountType.description: Account classification. Client self-registration is strictly restricted to 'individual' or 'business'.

organizationName.description: Optional salon, spa, clinic, distributor, or company name.

role.description: Server/admin-controlled RBAC role. Strictly forced to 'customer' on client create and immutable on client update.

accountStatus.description: Server/admin-controlled account lifecycle status. Strictly forced to 'active' on client create and immutable on client update.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp set on profile creation; immutable thereafter.

updatedAt.description: Firestore server timestamp updated on profile modification.

QuotationProductSnapshot.title: QuotationProductSnapshot
QuotationProductSnapshot.description: Immutable point-in-time snapshot of a requested product captured inside /quotationRequests/{quotationRequestId}.

productId.description: Composite product document ID (e.g. barber-chairs-pf-001) or 'custom'.

categoryId.description: Category ID paired with productCode to prevent cross-category PF collisions.

categoryName.description: Snapshot of category display label at inquiry time.

productCode.description: Snapshot of official PF model code or CUSTOM.

productName.description: Snapshot of catalogue product title at inquiry time.

customizationDetails.description: Optional customization notes for this line item.

materialFinishPreferences.description: Optional upholstery, colour, or finish preference.

indicativeBaseRateInr.description: Snapshot of indicative INR starting rate at inquiry time (or null for custom). Not a fixed selling price.

imagePath.description: Optional snapshot of portable primary image path at submission time.

QuotationInternalNote.title: QuotationInternalNote
QuotationInternalNote.description: Internal Priya Furniture staff review note physically isolated in /quotationRequests/{quotationRequestId}/internalNotes/{noteId}. Strictly default-deny for public and customer SDK access.

QuotationRequest.title: QuotationRequest
QuotationRequest.description: Authoritative Priya Furniture quotation request stored in /quotationRequests/{quotationRequestId}. Public and authenticated customers may create with strict validation and status='submitted'; authenticated owners may read/list only their own records; zero client update/delete; internal notes physically isolated in subcollection.

userId.description: Nullable /users/{userId} reference (request.auth.uid when signed in; null for guest public inquiries).

organizationName.description: Customer business, salon, spa, or organization name.

requestedProducts.description: Bounded array (1 to 10) of QuotationProductSnapshot objects.

totalQuantity.description: Sum of unit quantities across requestedProducts (1 to 100000).

deliveryLocation.description: Project delivery city, state, or site address.

additionalRequirements.description: Optional timeline, room layout, or special project instructions.

status.description: Controlled customer-visible quotation lifecycle status. Strictly forced to 'submitted' on client create.

revisionNumber.description: Monotonic revision counter starting at 1 for future quotation revisions.

parentQuotationRequestId.description: Nullable link to a parent quotationRequests document when branched.

activeQuotationVersionId.description: Nullable pointer to an active formal quotation revision document.

convertedOrderId.description: Nullable pointer to a future sales order document after conversion.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp set on creation.

updatedAt.description: Firestore server timestamp updated on modification.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Basic unpopulated application settings document structure for future ERP configuration. Strictly default-deny in Phase 2.2.

schemaVersion.description: Integer schema version for forward-compatible configuration migrations.

updatedBy.description: Nullable future administrator UID who last updated this setting document.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp set on creation.

updatedAt.description: Firestore server timestamp updated on modification.

QuoteRequestItem.title: QuoteRequestItem
QuoteRequestItem.description: A single furniture line item within an active public B2B quotation inquiry (/quoteRequests).

productSlug.description: Catalogue product slug or 'custom' for bespoke builds.

categoryId.description: Category identifier paired with productCode to prevent cross-category PF code collisions.

productCode.description: Official Priya Furniture model code (e.g. PF 006) or CUSTOM.

productName.description: Snapshot of the catalogue model display name at submission time.

dimensions.description: Optional standard or custom dimension notes.

materialFinish.description: Optional upholstery, colour, or finish preference.

indicativeUnitRate.description: Indicative INR starting rate snapshot at inquiry time (0 for custom builds). Not a fixed selling price.

QuoteRequest.title: QuoteRequest
QuoteRequest.description: Existing active public B2B quotation inquiry submitted via the Request a Quote desk (/quoteRequests).

status.description: Workflow lifecycle state. Public submissions are strictly forced to 'new'.

organisationName.description: Customer salon, spa, clinic, or company name.

contactPerson.description: Primary customer contact name and optional role.

deliveryLocation.description: Delivery city, state, or site location.

additionalRequirements.description: Optional timeline, room layout, or customisation notes.

items.description: Bounded schedule of 1 to 10 QuoteRequestItem objects.

itemCount.description: Total number of line items (must match items.length, 1 to 10).

totalQuantity.description: Sum of requested unit quantities across all line items (1 to 100000).

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp set at creation.

updatedAt.description: Firestore server timestamp matching createdAt at creation.

/products/{productId}.description: ERP product master collection (composite ID `${categoryId}-${normalizedCode}`). Unpopulated and default-deny in Phase 2.2 while static catalogue remains source of truth.

/categories/{categoryId}.description: ERP category registry preserving the four existing collections. Unpopulated and default-deny in Phase 2.2 while static catalogue remains source of truth.

/users/{userId}.description: Active Firebase Auth user profiles, addresses, and server-controlled role metadata. Owner-only get/create/update; zero list/delete; zero client role escalation.

/quotationRequests/{quotationRequestId}.description: Authoritative Priya Furniture quotation requests collection. Public & authenticated create (status='submitted', userId=null or auth.uid); owner-only customer get/list; zero client update/delete.

/quotationRequests/{quotationRequestId}/.description: Physically isolated internal staff review notes subcollection. Strictly default-deny for public and customer SDK access.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Unpopulated singleton application configuration documents (general, quotation, catalogue). Strictly default-deny.

/quoteRequests/{quoteId}.description: Retired legacy Phase 2.1 public quotation intake collection. Locked as default-deny in Phase 2.4 while preserving any historical records intact.
